items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: The old man, Tats, daddy was janitor over there, he was our recording financial secretary. We used to call him in them days.

ctx.x: Did they have a union in those days or was it very active or strong?

No, the union wasn't so very active around in the early parts of the twenties. I think I first joined the union in 19…let's see, I went into 1928, something like that. When George Augustine and formerly old bass player, and I forget that other man used to play a band, Willie Bontem. Oh, yeah. I met him once. Yeah, Willie Bontem. We sat at the old St. Catherine Hall on Tulane Avenue, I believe in South Villiers, somewhere up in the neighborhood. Yeah, the old St. Catherine Hall. It's still there. It's still there,…
Yeah. Did his father have a nickname?
